admission.justification: A bad starting fixture or inherited untouched finding could otherwise be scored as actor misconduct, while a copied desired result could make the trial meaningless.

applicability: Admission, reset and before/after memory validation of declared Curator eval cases.
conditions: Case actorInputs are hash-bound, only declared actor inputs enter a fresh fixture, and grader-only inputs stay outside it.
The native copied tree is checked using the product writer validation split.
Inherited unchanged findings retain before/after hashes; new blocking findings and findings remaining on actor-written files are attributed separately.
exclusions: Relaxation of the product writer or closeout whole-tree validator.
Silently restoring a baseline when the case does not authorize it.

evidence: Frozen tree fd6462b85ba9d06f004e323384ea800f9aa5144a, base 59b01fb8f72a38d2d27f9c37b8b9ca2513fd3fa0; path bindings and source hashes in producer-manifest.json; Reviewer R4 and d229-repairs/report.md.

statement: Case reset and preflight bind the declared input bytes and compare writer validation without converting inherited untouched findings into actor conduct.
